ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows a ratio of approximately 60% high-intensity (white/cream) to 40% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupy the outer lateral zones of both lobes. Heavy black mottling and stippling are concentrated in the central region surrounding the median notch, with dark pigmentation extending in a splayed, fan-like pattern towards the trailing edges. Distinct thin, vertical black streaks are present in the lower right lobe area.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated as a deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 95 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 1/6th of the visible vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible on both lobes. The left lobe trailing edge features multiple sharp jagged peaks. A significant, low-frequency deep indentation (missing tissue) is located on the left lobe trailing edge immediately adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lobes exhibit a convex sweep from the peduncle, with the distal tips exhibiting a sharp upward and outward curvature, more pronounced on the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A prominent cluster of circular, high-relief, high-contrast pixel groupings (acorn barnacles) is localized on the superior margin and tip of the left fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several fine, dark linear pixel disruptions resembling rake marks are visible within the white pigmentation field of the distal right lobe, oriented vertically.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A major traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the notch indicates significant prior tissue loss. Dense cluster of barnacles on the superior left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The cluster of 3D-protruding barnacles on the leading edge/tip of the left lobe creates a unique silhouette anomaly against the water background.
